name: Vector
source:
Age: 30 years old (?).
Nationality: Registered as an American (?).

He is an agent of the United Nations' Central Intelligence Agency (UIA - The name originated from the old American CIA), Vector is his codename. He also has the authority to directly command the UNCATS (United Nations Countermeasures Against Terrorism Section).
